doc: Convective tendency with a float32 latitude array: numpy keeps the whole chain in float32 (a Python float does not promote it), so the output is float32. Hadley edge 30. Tolerance rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-6 (the default): measured against the float64-promoted computation (max abs 1.4e-7) and a one-ulp nudge of the latitudes (max abs 2.4e-7, 0.06 of the default band).

params.dtype_chain: lat float32: x, the gaussians, the smoothstep and the clip are float32 (Python floats are weak): the output is float32.
